cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID. The 99% figure is of citizens aged 16 and above.
cells.note: The 13.5 million registered in September 2026 are about 61% of people of all ages, though 99% of those aged 16 and over. The study counts the whole population, so two-thirds is not reached.
